// Native Promise resolution invokes a thenable in an engine job. That job must
// receive the same origin as the source await, including for its getter, its
// callable body and recursive resolution. The box prevents a fulfilled value
// from being assimilated for a second time by our transport Promise.
function adoptInScope(scope, input) {
    return (0, _nativepromiseallocation.createClientNativePromise)(NativePromise, (resolve, reject)=>{
        const fulfill = (value)=>{
            const box = Object.create(null);
            box.value = value;
            resolve(box);
        };
        const adopt = (value)=>runInScope(scope, ()=>{
                try {
                    if (value === null || typeof value !== 'object' && typeof value !== 'function') {
                        fulfill(value);
                        return;
                    }
                    const then = Reflect.get(value, 'then');
                    if (typeof then !== 'function') {
                        fulfill(value);
                        return;
                    }
                    Reflect.apply(nativeThen, settled, [
                        ()=>runInScope(scope, ()=>{
                                let called = false;
                                try {
                                    Reflect.apply(then, value, [
                                        (next)=>{
                                            if (called) return;
                                            called = true;
                                            adopt(next);
                                        },
                                        (error)=>{
                                            if (called) return;
                                            called = true;
                                            reject(error);
                                        }
                                    ]);
                                } catch (error) {
                                    if (!called) reject(error);
                                }
                            })
                    ]);
                } catch (error) {
                    reject(error);
                }
            });
        adopt(input);
    });
}

    }

function invalidatePort(port) {
    const peer = channelLinks.get(port);
    channelLinks.delete(port);
    messageScopes.delete(port);
    if (peer) {
        channelLinks.delete(peer);
        messageScopes.delete(peer);
    }
}
// Observe the transfer sequence as Web IDL actually consumes it. Reading a
// caller's options or iterable twice would change getter and iterator behavior.
function trackTransferOptions(options, transferred) {
    if (options === null || typeof options !== 'object' && typeof options !== 'function') return options;
    return new Proxy(Object.create(null), {
        get (_target, key) {
            const member = Reflect.get(options, key, options);
            if (key === 'transfer') return trackTransferOptions(member, transferred);
            if (key !== Symbol.iterator || typeof member !== 'function') return member;
            return function(...iteratorArgs) {
                const iterator = Reflect.apply(member, options, iteratorArgs);
                if (iterator === null || typeof iterator !== 'object' && typeof iterator !== 'function') return iterator;
                const next = Reflect.get(iterator, 'next');
                return {
                    next (...args) {
                        const item = Reflect.apply(next, iterator, args);
                        if (item === null || typeof item !== 'object' && typeof item !== 'function') return item;
                        if (Reflect.get(item, 'done')) return {
                            done: true
                        };
                        const value = Reflect.get(item, 'value');
                        if (channelLinks.has(value)) transferred.add(value);
                        return {
                            done: false,
                            value
                        };
                    },
                    get return () {
                        const close = Reflect.get(iterator, 'return');
                        return typeof close === 'function' ? (...args)=>Reflect.apply(close, iterator, args) : close;
                    }
                };
            };
        }
    });
}
function callWithTransfers(method, receiver, args, index) {
    const transferred = new Set();
    if (args.length > index) args[index] = trackTransferOptions(args[index], transferred);
    const result = Reflect.apply(method, receiver, args);
    for (const port of transferred)invalidatePort(port);
    return result;
}

/** A started operation retains only its exact private query and completion. */ function createClientCommandAdmission(scope, origin, signal) {
